title: Crohamhurst Observatory

notes: Whole surviving1935 timber observatory: actual front rectangular roof extent, low timber stumps, weatherboard body and currently enclosed north/east casement verandas, hipped fibre-cement roof with north/east/west louvred gablets and entry gable, attached southwest shed, and intrinsic Stevenson screen, low temperature-pit caps, remnant instrument strip and sundial/telescope-marker stands. Separate later residence/eastern house/workshop, trees/private garden/fences/cars/people excluded.
